methods.label: Evaluate the power and write scientific notation
methods.explanation: \(2^{-3}=\frac{1}{2^3}=\frac{1}{8}\). There are \(4\) zeros before the first nonzero digit \(3\) in \(0.00032\), so its scientific notation is \(3.2\times10^{-4}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 8 negative-exponent rule, supported by elementary powers and decimal place value.
